environment: Local FastAPI TestClient; demo data only; Supabase and OpenAI disabled

cases.expected: A finance wire-transfer query returns at least one finance-relevant policy.
cases.actual: Returned 2 record(s); the first record was finance/wire related.

evidence.first_content: FIN-SEC-04: All wire transfers exceeding $10,000 require secondary out-of-band verification (direct phone call to registered internal extension or in-person confirmation) with the CFO or Finance Director. Email or SMS approvals are strictly prohibited, even if purportedly sent by the CEO. Company payment information is never transmitted to unverified external email domains.

cases.expected: Relevant threat records consistently rank in the top three with strong precision and recall.
cases.actual: Hit@3 and MRR were 1.000, but Precision@3 was 0.567 and Recall@3 was 0.733.

cases.expected: Relevant training records consistently rank in the top three with strong precision and recall.
cases.actual: Hit@3 and MRR were 1.000, but Precision@3 was 0.542 and Recall@3 was 0.750.

cases.expected: An unmatched query returns no guidance or an explicit low-confidence response.
cases.actual: The retriever returned 2 default module(s) despite no matching topic.

cases.expected: Every retrieved fallback guidance record includes a direct source URL or stable document identifier.
cases.actual: 2 returned fallback record(s) had a source label but no direct URL in metadata.

source_labels: SANS Securing The Human - Executive Impersonation

cases.expected: When vector services are unavailable, deterministic local retrieval still returns relevant threat records.
cases.actual: Local fallback returned 3 record(s).

cases.actual: Validation accepted=False; errors reported an unknown citation.

cases.expected: A protected scenario endpoint returns HTTP 401 without a bearer token.
cases.actual: HTTP 401.

response.detail: Authentication required. Please provide a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

cases.expected: A malformed or invalid bearer token is rejected.
cases.actual: HTTP 401.

cases.expected: The service refuses to start or rejects tokens when JWT_SECRET is absent or too short.
cases.actual: With JWT_SECRET empty, a token signed using the known fallback secret obtained HTTP 200 from the admin endpoint.

cases.expected: Hard-coded demonstration credentials are unavailable through the normal login endpoint.
cases.actual: The embedded administrator credentials returned HTTP 200 and an access token.

cases.expected: A bearer token becomes unusable immediately after logout.
cases.actual: Logout returned HTTP 200; the same token still returned HTTP 200 from /api/auth/me.

cases.expected: A different authenticated learner cannot read another learner's scenario.
cases.actual: Cross-user request returned HTTP 404.

cases.expected: A different learner cannot evaluate a scenario they do not own.
cases.actual: Cross-user evaluation returned HTTP 404.

cases.expected: A learner token cannot access the administrator user-list endpoint.
cases.actual: Learner request returned HTTP 403.

response.detail: Access denied. Required role(s): admin. Your role: 'learner'

cases.expected: An unknown scenario identifier is rejected rather than replaced by demo data.
cases.actual: HTTP 404.

response.detail: Scenario not found for authenticated user

cases.expected: The evaluation API accepts only a choice from the stored scenario.
cases.actual: Invented action returned HTTP 422.

response.detail: Selected action is not one of this scenario's choices

cases.expected: The Coach uses the stored server-side evaluation and ignores a client-submitted score of 100.
cases.actual: Stored score was 37.2; Coach path reason referenced the stored score.

evidence.reason_for_path: Adaptive path set to beginner based on score of 37.2/100.

cases.expected: Production-facing requests are redirected to HTTPS or rejected when sent over HTTP.
cases.actual: The application accepted an HTTP request and returned HTTP 200; TLS is an external deployment assumption.
